description: This file defines an abstract test class 'ScopedTransactionsTestRunnerxUnit' which extends 'ScopedTransactionsTestRunner'. It provides overridden test methods decorated with custom attributes to execute various transaction scope tests on different grain states within an Orleans transaction testing framework using XUnit.

classes.name: ScopedTransactionsTestRunnerxUnit
classes.description: An abstract class extending the base 'ScopedTransactionsTestRunner' to run transaction scope tests with XUnit.

methods.name: CreateTransactionScopeAndSetValue
methods.description: Overrides base method; runs transaction tests for setting values in grains under various configurations.

methods.name: CreateTransactionScopeAndSetValueWithFailure
methods.description: Overrides base method; tests transaction scope behavior under failure conditions.

methods.name: CreateTransactionScopeAndSetValueAndAssert
methods.description: Overrides base method; runs transaction scope tests with assertions.

methods.name: CreateNestedTransactionScopeAndSetValueAndInnerFailAndAssert
methods.description: Overrides base method; tests nested transaction scope behavior with inner failures and assertions.
